The `member.joined` event is defined in `src/types/event.ts` and emitted by `invitation-service.ts` when an invitation is accepted. Two files register handlers for it: `notification-service.ts` (line 231) and `usage-service.ts` (line 89). Those are the only `subscribe("member.joined", …)` calls in the repo.

Between them, those two files import five repository modules:

- `notification-service.ts` imports `issue-repository`, `notification-repository`, `organization-repository` and `notification-preference-repository`. The `member.joined` handler itself only uses `organization-repository`, but the question is about file-level imports, so I included all four.
- `usage-service.ts` imports `organization-repository` and `usage-repository`.

`organization-repository` appears in both files, so it is listed once.
